reuse.why: No shared definition of 'protected category' is introduced or reused; each action gets its own inline SQL fragment and the existing getBudgetData shape is merely extended.

duplication.why: The same `goal_def IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(template_settings,'$.source'),'notes') = 'ui'` expression is pasted four times (getBudgetData, setZero, set3MonthAvg, set12MonthAvg) and the hidden checks stay split between JS conditions and SQL WHERE clauses.

placement.why: Changes stay in budget/actions.ts with the actions, though the template-ownership rule is embedded in raw SQL rather than next to the template code.

scope.why: Focused on the month-wide actions plus one test, but inconsistently: set6MonthAvg is left untouched.

maintainability.why: Four copies of a non-obvious SQL predicate in two different shapes (CASE column vs NOT(...) filter) and one action already missed show the rule will drift.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared category-selection abstraction exists in this tree to bypass; the change simply does not create one.

disguised_duplication.where: The saved-template predicate appears as a CASE ... AS has_saved_templates column in getBudgetData and setZero and as an AND NOT (...) filter in set3MonthAvg/set12MonthAvg, the same rule reshaped per site.

one_place.where: Rule is copied into getBudgetData/copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg in budget/actions.ts; set6MonthAvg does not apply the template rule at all.
